v5.10.10 - Multiple support-card dating schedules
Added ----- - Support Card Dating now supports multiple cards at once, each with its own name, preset, pinned turns, Pure Passion turn, and outing count. When more than one card is configured, rows in the in-game "Choose Recreation Partner" dialog are matched by name to the right schedule. Leave a card's name blank to match any unclaimed row (the previous single-card behavior, unchanged when only one card is configured).
